_comment: 'As an additional cost to play this, you may charge your hero's soul. When this hits, if a yellow card was charged this way, this gets go again.' The implementation is already right: an optional CHARGE cost that stamps the charged card's colour, and an injected ON_HIT trigger gated on CHARGED_THIS_WAY yellow. Only the printed keyword was unconditional, so the card had go again without charging anything and without hitting. Declared rather than converted because the condition is a HIT -- there is no state for a static to read before the attack connects.
